attacks.claim: The record proposes the commercial section (b67, CPCA 531 as replaced by Law 22-13) but never says that the same law replaced CPCA 534 so that the president of the commercial section must first refer every dispute to mediation, without the parties' consent. The checklist asks the question (k55) and nothing in the record answers it.

source.what: Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022 amending CPCA 08-09, art. 3 (new CPCA art. 534), Official Journal no. 48 of 17 July 2022, pp. 3-4

attacks.quoteArabic: "المادّة 534 : يجب على رئيس القسم التجاري عرض النزاع مسبقا على الوساطة. لا تخضع الوساطة أمام القسم التجاري إلى قبول الأطراف، خلافا لأحكام المادّة 994 من هذا القانون. تطبّق على الوساطة أمام القسم التجاري أحكام الوساطة المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون".
attacks.consequence: Wherever the record sends the claim to the commercial section, it should tell the lawyer that compulsory mediation comes before the hearing. Law 22-13 art. 13 defers only the jurisdiction rules for the administrative and specialised commercial courts, not art. 534. This also matters for timing: the lessee's three months (d1) target the service of the summons, and mediation does not move that date.

attacks.claim: Boundary n15 says that the texts 'do not say which court is competent' when the lessor or lessee is the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body, and the record still proposes the commercial section. CPCA 800 ¶2 does name the court: the administrative court hears every case to which these persons are party. CPCA 802 lists the exceptions, and no lease dispute is among them.

source.what: Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022, art. 4 (new CPCA art. 800), Official Journal no. 48 of 17 July 2022, p. 5; the 2008 wording (store, cpca 800 ¶2, version law-08-09) is the same on this point

attacks.quoteArabic: تختص المحاكم الإدارية بالفصل في أول درجة بحكم قابل للاستئناف في جميع القضايا التي تكون الدولة أو الولاية أو البلدية أو إحدى المؤسسات العمومية ذات الصبغة الإدارية أو الهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية طرفا فيها.
attacks.consequence: When public_body_party is yes and the body is the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body, the record should give an exit to the administrative court (at least a warning that names CPCA 800), not 'court to check' while the commercial section stays proposed. Public economic enterprises (b4, Commercial Code 170 ¶3) are not covered by CPCA 800, so the slot should tell the two apart.

attacks.claim: Request r9 ('order renewal of the lease for (...) and fix its rent and terms') is offered for every pre-2005 commercial lease, citing 197 ¶1. But 176 ¶1 lets the lessor refuse renewal, with the eviction compensation as the only sanction, and 197 ¶1 gives the lessee only two actions: contesting the ground of the refusal or claiming the compensation. A court fixes the terms of a renewal only where the lessor accepted it (195), is deemed to have accepted it (174 ¶4), or later chooses renewal under 197 ¶6.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 of 26 September 1975 (Commercial Code), arts. 176 and 197, Official Journal no. 101 of 19 December 1975, pp. 1323 and 1327

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 176 : يجوز للمؤجر أن يرفض تجديد الايجار، غير أنه ينبغي عليه فيما عدا الاستثناءات المنصوص عليها في المادة 177 وما يليها أن يسدد للمستأجر المخلى التعويض ... / المادة 197 : اذا رفض المؤجر تجديد الايجار ورغب المستأجر اما في منازعة سبب هذا الرفض، أو طلب سداد تعويض الاخلاء ...
attacks.consequence: r9 should be offered only where renewal was accepted, deemed accepted (n4) or chosen by the lessor under 197 ¶6. After a refusal, the lessee's request is the compensation (r3), not a judgment ordering the renewal. As written, a lawyer may draft a request the court will reject as having no legal basis.

attacks.claim: Request r2 asks, for every pre-2005 lease, that the lessee leave 'once he has received the eviction compensation', and r5 records a right to stay until it is paid. Article 187 ¶1 gives that right only to a lessee who can claim the compensation. It does not reach a refusal on a serious and legitimate ground (177 ¶1, after the warning of 177 ¶2), demolition for unfitness or danger (177 ¶3), a lessee without the operating period of 172, or substitute premises (187 ¶2: he leaves once the provisional compensation is paid).

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), arts. 177 and 187, Official Journal no. 101 of 19 December 1975, pp. 1323-1325

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 187 : لا يجوز الزام أى مستأجر يمكنه المطالبة بتعويض الاخلاء بمغادرة الاماكن قبل قبض التعويض / المادة 177 : يجوز للمؤجر أن يرفض تجديد الايجار دون أن يلزم بسداد أى تعويض، اذا برهن عن سبب خطير ومشروع تجاه المستأجر المخلى المحل
attacks.consequence: r2 needs a second wording, eviction without compensation on the ground of 177 (or of 172 lacking), conditioned on refusal_without_compensation_for_breach or a demolition slot. r5 should be offered only when compensation is owed. As written, the lessor's own petition concedes a compensation the law may not impose.

attacks.claim: The slot that triggers d2 lists the nullity of a notice to quit as an action 'other than contesting a refusal to renew', so a lessee's action to annul the notice gets the two-year limitation of 198 and d1 stays silent. But the Code treats the notice to quit as the lessor's refusal to renew: 175 ¶3 names it as one of the two ways the lessor notifies his refusal, 178 ¶4 joins 'the act refusing renewal or the notice to quit', and 173 ¶5 requires the notice to restate 194, whose three months run from that notification. A lessee attacking the notice is contesting the refusal, which 198 excludes when it carves out the actions of 196 and 197.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), arts. 173 ¶5, 175 ¶3, 194 ¶1, 197 ¶3, 198 ¶1, Official Journal no. 101 of 19 December 1975, pp. 1323, 1326, 1327

attacks.quoteArabic: غير انه عندما يبلغ المؤجر عن طريق التنبيه بالاخلاء او عن طريق رفض التجديد عن نيته فى عدم تجديد الايجار ... / ويجب في هذه الحالة تبليغ التكليف بالحضور في الثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ تبليغ رفض التجديد / ترفع جميع الدعاوى الممارسة وفقا لما ورد في هذا الباب ماعدا الدعاوى المشار اليها في المادتين 196 و 197 أعلاه ... ويشملها التقادم بعد مرور سنتين
attacks.consequence: Remove the nullity of the notice to quit from the slot's examples, or let d1 also fire (warning) for a lessee's claim that attacks a notice to quit (r4). Otherwise a lessee's lawyer is told he has two years when the protective reading gives him three months from service of the notice.

attacks.claim: Prior step p1 and its slot know only one case: notice six months before 'the end of the lease term'. 173 ¶3 and ¶4, in the same article, add two common cases. A lease ending on a resolutory condition ends only by a notification six months ahead that must mention the fulfilment of the condition. A lease in stages (the usual 3-6-9) needs the notice within the periods of ¶1 before the end of the stage at which the lessor ends it.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), art. 173 ¶3 and ¶4, Official Journal no. 101 of 19 December 1975, p. 1323

attacks.quoteArabic: لا تنتهي مدة الإيجار الواقف على شرط والذي يسمح تحقيقه للمؤجر بأن يطلب الفسخ إلا بتبليغ واقع قبل ستة أشهر قبل الأجل ولأجل مألوف، ويجب أن يشير هذا الإعلان إلى تحقيق الشرط المنصوص عليه في العقد. وعندما يتضمن الإيجار عدة مراحل فإنه يجب التنبيه بالإخلاء في الآجال المنصوص عليها في الفقرة الأولى أعلاه، إذا فسخ المؤجر الإيجار في نهاية إحدى هذه المراحل.
attacks.consequence: The slot question should measure the six months from the end of the stage at which the lease is ended (¶4). For a conditional lease, it should also ask whether the notification mentions the fulfilment of the condition (¶3). Otherwise a lawyer ending a 3-6-9 lease at the third year gets a wrong question, and a conditional-lease notice without the mention passes.

attacks.claim: Lead only. A settled line of the Supreme Court (commercial chamber), as commonly reported, reads the three months of 194/197 as a forfeiture period. A lessee served with a valid notice to quit who does not sue within it loses the eviction compensation and becomes an occupant without right or title, whom the lessor may have evicted without compensation. The record keeps the 'directory period' reading on an equal footing (d1 readings, o2), and r2 and r5 always pair the eviction with prior payment of compensation.

source.what: My own memory of Supreme Court decisions published in المجلة القضائية (no decision number or date retrieved). Searches of coursupreme.dz through the web search in this run found nothing; a Bejaia university thesis on the effects of the notice to quit (univ-bejaia.dz handle 123456789/24223) could not be read (text not extractable).

attacks.quoteArabic: المستأجر الذي لم يرفع دعواه خلال أجل ثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ تبليغه بالتنبيه بالإخلاء يسقط حقه في التعويض الاستحقاقي ويصبح شاغلا بدون حق ولا سند (wording from memory, not verified)
attacks.consequence: If this is verified on the Supreme Court's own publications, the forfeiture reading should be the record's protective lead for the lessee (d1). The lessor side also needs a case: a pre-2005 lessor seeking eviction after the lessee let the three months pass, where r2's 'after receiving the compensation' would be wrong.

attacks.claim: The slot for the operating period (two consecutive years, or four) does not say when the period must be complete. 172 ¶4 fixes it: the period ends at the end of the lease or, where the lease was extended, at the date of the notice to quit or at the usual term after the renewal request. Counting up to the petition date, which the question invites, can wrongly satisfy the condition.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), art. 172 ¶4, Official Journal no. 101 of 19 December 1975, p. 1323

attacks.quoteArabic: وتنتهى هذه المدة بانتهاء عقد الايجار او عند الاقتضاء بتاريخ تمديده حسبما هو منصوص عليه فى المادة 173 التالية، ويعتبر هذا التاريخ الاخير اما بمثابة التاريخ الذى تم فيه التنبيه باخلاء واما الاجل المألوف الذى يلى هذا الطلب ... فى حالة وقوع طلب تجديد
attacks.consequence: The question of n5 should ask whether the two or four years were complete at the end of the lease, or at the date of the notice to quit or of the term after the renewal request, and should cite 172 ¶4.

attacks.claim: The regime tests use only 'before 2005-02-09' (d1, p1, p2, p4, p5, n4, n5) and 'after 2005-02-09' (n1, n2, n3, n6, n7). A lease made exactly on 2005-02-09 matches neither, so no regime rule fires. The text puts leases made 'from the date of publication' in the new regime, so that date belongs on the new side (at least with a caution).
attacks.evidenceWords: المبرمة ابتداء من تاريخ نشر هذا القانون في الجريدة الرسمية

attacks.claim: n4 fires on 'renewal_request_unanswered_three_months' alone and never checks that the renewal request was valid. A request without the required wording is void, so it starts no three-month period and creates no deemed acceptance. The same applies to a refusal that omits article 194, which is void.
attacks.evidenceWords: ويجب ان يشمل الطلب مضمون الفقرة المدرجة بعده والا كان باطلا

attacks.claim: d1 starts the three months from the service of any refusal, including the answer to a renewal request and the notice to quit. The texts make a refusal answer void unless it restates article 194, and make a notice to quit void unless it states its reasons and restates article 194. A void act should not start the period, but d1 has no validity condition.
attacks.evidenceWords: ويجب ان يذكر فى التبليغ المنصوص عليه فى الفقرة السابقة مضمون المادة 194 والا كان باطلا

attacks.claim: Article 197 ¶3 requires the summons to be served (تبليغ التكليف بالحضور) within three months. d1 is a procedural period with no counting method and no basis for month counting or weekend and holiday extension (d2 does carry a counting block), and it does not say that the measured event is service of the summons rather than filing the petition. A drafting tool that compares the petition date will misjudge the deadline.
attacks.evidenceWords: ويجب في هذه الحالة تبليغ التكليف بالحضور في الثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ تبليغ رفض التجديد

attacks.claim: n5 fires on 'lessee_operated_business_required_period = no' alone. Article 172 ¶2 lets a lessee who shows a legitimate reason, or who let the business under a management lease, still rely on the operation, so that case must not fire. The English message also says 'under a written lease' for the two-year case, but the Arabic does not say written there.
attacks.evidenceWords: غير انه يجوز للمستأجر الذى يثبت بسبب مشروع او الذى اجر متجره ضمن الشروط المنصوص عليها فى الاحكام القانونية المتعلقة، بايجار التسيير فانه يجوز له ان يتمسك بالاستغلال

attacks.claim: b22 drops the qualifier 'without a serious and legitimate reason' on cessation of operation. As written, any cessation needs a prior warning, while the text covers only non-performance or cessation without a serious and legitimate reason. A cessation with a legitimate reason is a different case.
attacks.evidenceWords: بالتوقف عن استغلال المحل التجارى دون سبب جدي ومشروع

attacks.claim: Exit x1 says a rent-revision dispute goes to the president of the court under the summary procedure, citing article 192. Article 192 ¶3 says only 'the competent court' and refers to articles 195 and 196. The reference to the summary procedure is therefore indirect, and the message presents it as stated by 192.
attacks.evidenceWords: يرفع الطلب من الطرف الذى يهمه الاستعجال لدى الجهة القضائية المختصة

attacks.claim: The window 'before 2005-03-10' is a 30-day period that no cited text states. Article 4 ¶2 fixes effect by arrival of the Official Journal at each daira's seat, which varies by place. The window also excludes a lease on 2005-02-09 itself. n1 and n2 still fire for leases inside the window, so one case receives both a firm 'outside' warning and an 'unsettled' warning.
attacks.evidenceWords: وفى النواحى الاخرى فى نطاق كل دائرة بعد مضى يوم كامل من تاريخ وصول الجريدة الرسمية الى مقر الدائرة

attacks.claim: Article 194 ¶1 makes the dispute go to court only after three months from the notification without agreement. No prior-step or premature-filing rule models this wait. d1 treats the same three months as a time limit, so a lessee who files before the three months run, or who files late, receives no clear warning.
attacks.evidenceWords: في حالة عدم اتفاق الطرفين عند انتهاء مهلة ثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ التبليغ

attacks.claim: The module has no slot separating the date of the original lease from the date of a renewal or new contract. n1, n2, p1 and d1 test only 'contract_date'. For a pre-2005 lease renewed by a contract signed after 2005, a lawyer who enters the later date triggers n1 and n2 ('no compensation', 'void for form'). Article 187 مكرر 1 says renewal of the earlier lease stays under the old law. n13 has no 'when' and never fires.
attacks.evidenceWords: يبقى تجديد عقود الإيجار المبرمة قبل النشر المذكور في المادة 187 مكرر أعلاه، خاضعا للتشريع الساري المفعول بتاريخ إبرام عقد الإيجار

attacks.claim: Rent revision has no prior-step rule. Article 192 requires a request by extrajudicial act or registered letter stating the rent, void if the rent is not stated. Article 193 allows the request only after three years. n14 only warns 'check the subject' and the p-rules cover only the notice to quit, refusal, rent demand and priority notice.
attacks.evidenceWords: ويجب تحت طائلة البطلان، أن يحدد بدل الإيجار المطلوب أو المعروض

attacks.claim: b54 merges the two start points of the fifteen days. The text runs them from the day the judgment becomes final for a first-instance judgment, and from the day the judgment is given for the appeal court. Dropping this distinction gives a wrong start date.
attacks.evidenceWords: ابتداء من يوم صدور الحكم اذا كان الامر يتعلق بالمجلس القضائي

attacks.claim: b31 states the six-month and six-year occupation duty without the exception for a legitimate reason. The text excepts a legitimate reason, and the compensation is proportional to the premises recovered, not the full compensation.
attacks.evidenceWords: باستثناء السبب المشروع، اذا لم يوجد أن يشغل بنفسه الاماكن

attacks.claim: b4 says the provisions extend to leases granted to communes for municipal operating services. It drops the condition that the owner consented, expressly or tacitly, when the lease was made or afterwards.
attacks.evidenceWords: وبالموافقة الصريحة أو الضمنية من المالك

attacks.claim: b63 says a Civil Code lease ends at its term with no need for notice, and n8 relies on it. The uncited paragraph 2 lets the lessee end the lease early for a family or professional reason, with two months' notice by a non-judicial document. The rule is stated without this exception.
attacks.evidenceWords: غير أنه يجوز للمستأجر إنهاء عقد الإيجار قبل ذلك لسبب عائلي أو مهني

Warning on 2026-06-15, one month ends on the same day number, 2026-07-15. On 2026-06-29 the month has certainly not run under any counting, so the lessor cannot yet rely on the breach.
